import ast, pathlib, re
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
source = (root / 'tests/test_ci_followon_wiring.py').read_text()
tree = ast.parse(source)
fn = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == '_tool_pin')
ns = {'re': re, 'REPO_ROOT': root, 'TOOL_PINS_PATH': root / '.github/tool-pins.env'}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn], type_ignores=[]), '<pin-helper>', 'exec'), ns)
workflow = (root / '.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text()
for name in ('TRIVY_VERSION', 'TRIVY_LINUX_64BIT_SHA256', 'ACTIONLINT_VERSION', 'ACTIONLINT_SHA256'):
    value = ns['_tool_pin'](name)
    key = 'TRIVY_SHA256' if name == 'TRIVY_LINUX_64BIT_SHA256' else name
    assert f'{key}: "{value}"' in workflow
assert '.planning' not in source
print('All four pins match CI; wiring module has no planning-directory reference.')
PY
